title: FactRecord
description: What a consumer asserts about one vessel at one moment: the input evaluateDisplay reads (ADR 0011 §2, ADR 0015). Structure only -- which fact keys exist and which values each takes is data/facts.json's, checked in the tests; see docs/adr/0006-json-schema-and-identifier-diff.md.
$comment: A case's `facts` in schema/applicability-fixtures.schema.json is this shape plus minProperties: 1 -- a fixture must assert something; an evaluation input need not, and `{}` is a record that asserts nothing. Values are string, number or boolean, as data/facts.json declares them; null and positions belong to the situation classes.
